risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing-suspect mail delivered (T1566.002), impossible travel indicating valid-account misuse (T1078.004), API-created inbox forwarding rule to an external Gmail (T1114.003), and bulk SIS access from an external IP within one hour (T1213). These verified findings form a coherent compromise sequence (initial access -> account use -> persistence/exfiltration -> data access). The rejected password-spray claim does not undermine the direct evidence of takeover. Containment is warranted.
